# Verbisto

> Verbisto is an iPhone app for practising Spanish verb conjugation (Spanish from Spain, every person including vosotros). You type each verb form yourself; the app shows which part went wrong (the stem, the ending or the accent) and explains the rule for that one part. Explanations are in English and Russian.

- Platform: iPhone, iOS 26 or later. Works offline; a connection is needed only for purchases.
- Tenses: Pretérito Indefinido, Pretérito Imperfecto, Pretérito Perfecto, Pretérito Pluscuamperfecto, Futuro Simple.
- Price: free download. Indefinido and Perfecto are free forever. The full version is a yearly subscription (first 7 days free), a monthly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase (shareable via Family Sharing).
- Answers are always typed. Forms you get wrong come back for review.
- Usage taught is that of Spain (perfecto for "today" / "this week"); vosotros is included.
- App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6836263523
